http.mode: real local container HTTP and PostgreSQL; no interception or chain broadcasts
checks: production API identifies Devnet, expected build and PostgreSQL storage
real database health and network status remain distinct from settlement authorization
anonymous privileged reads and writes fail closed
built assets, safe browser settings, cache policies and deep links are served by the real container
two real replicas share PostgreSQL single-use approval and authenticated post/read
message deletion and session revocation persist across actual HTTP requests

browser.mode: real local container browser; no request interception

restart.mode: real production container restart and shared PostgreSQL

limitations: Local disposable containers; not a deployed public site.
No Solana transactions or funded wallets used.
Candidate image precedes subsequent startup and metadata MIME fixes; final image must be rebuilt and verified.
